conf.description: sharepoint-onprem audit, format jdbc-sql: Database Collector high-water read of dbo.AuditData (READ UNCOMMITTED, read-only), columns arrive already typed so no delimited parse is needed; dedupe by (SiteId, Occurred, Event, UserId, ItemId), same rename-to-ECS as the api-pull format.

conf.comment: sharepoint-onprem/audit/jdbc-sql. Database Collector reads dbo.AuditData directly (read-only, READ UNCOMMITTED, high-water mark on Occurred) -- columns arrive already typed, so no delimited/JSON parse step runs here. Same Event enum / UserId->login gaps as the api-pull format: no full enum table and no UserInfo lookup data are supplied by the work order, so neither is resolved.
